rationale: Skyhook Engineering is a small North Lakes structural consultancy hiring a Revit draftsperson across varied building types.
Ad restricts applicants to Australian citizens or permanent residents and wants 2+ years' hands-on commercial Revit experience.
Marc's Revit use is academic (bridge/footing models), not commercial production drafting, and his visa is not citizenship/PR.
caution: Hard citizenship/PR-only restriction is stated explicitly, and role is structural (not civil) drafting.
gaps: Revit experience is academic coursework, not 2+ years of commercial structural drafting
mandatory_unmet: "Australian citizenship or permanent residents only" (Marc holds a Subclass 485 visa to December 2027, not citizenship or permanent residency)
"2+ years hands-on Revit experience" (Marc's Revit experience is academic coursework, not commercial production drafting)
apply_instructions: Email CV and a few sample drawing sheets (PDF) to admin@skyhookengineering.com.au.
title: Structural Draftsperson (Revit)
screening_questions: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
What's your expected annual base salary?
How many years' experience do you have as a structural drafter?
How many years of commercial design experience do you have?
How many years' experience do you have as a Revit Documenter?
